title: Virtbase — Traffic & 95th Percentile
description: Transit usage from Akvorado's ClickHouse. Set the range to a calendar month for the billing figure.

list.name: table
list.label: Source table
list.description: flows_5m0s: 3 months at 5-minute resolution, what billing wants. Pair with $bucket.

list.name: bucket
list.label: Bucket (s)
list.description: Match to $table: 300 / 3600 / 60. Billing panels always use 300.

list.name: sr
list.label: Sampling multiplier
list.description: Verified: Akvorado does NOT pre-scale consolidated tables. Leave on SamplingRate.

panels.title: 95th percentile — the number the transit bill is written against
95th percentile OUT

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantileExact(0.95)(bps) AS p95 FROM (
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) AS t,
       sum(if(OutIfBoundary = 'external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / 300 AS bps
FROM $table
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
GROUP BY t
)

panels.description: Egress on every interface classified external, 5-minute buckets, over the dashboard range. Set the range to a calendar month for the billing figure. quantileExact, not quantile: the approximate one drifts ~0.1% over a month and a carrier computes this exactly.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantileExact(0.95)(bps) AS p95 FROM (
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) AS t,
       sum(if(InIfBoundary = 'external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / 300 AS bps
FROM $table
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
GROUP BY t
)

panels.title: Billable (higher of the two)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT greatest(
 (SELECT quantileExact(0.95)(bps) FROM (
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) AS t,
       sum(if(OutIfBoundary = 'external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / 300 AS bps
FROM $table
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
GROUP BY t
 )),
 (SELECT quantileExact(0.95)(bps) FROM (
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) AS t,
       sum(if(InIfBoundary = 'external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / 300 AS bps
FROM $table
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
GROUP BY t
 ))
) AS billable

panels.description: Most transit contracts bill the higher direction.

panels.title: Peak OUT

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(bps) AS peak FROM (
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) AS t,
       sum(if(OutIfBoundary = 'external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / 300 AS bps
FROM $table
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
GROUP BY t
)

panels.description: What the percentile discards. A wide gap to the 95th means short bursts you are not billed for.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(if(OutIfBoundary='external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) AS v FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
SELECT sum(if(InIfBoundary='external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) AS v FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)

panels.title: Transit throughput, 5-minute buckets, with the 95th percentile

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) AS t,
         sum(if(OutIfBoundary = 'external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / 300 AS out_bps,
         sum(if(InIfBoundary  = 'external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / 300 AS in_bps
  FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) GROUP BY t
)
SELECT t AS time, out_bps AS "out", -in_bps AS "in (mirrored)",
       (SELECT quantileExact(0.95)(out_bps) FROM b) AS "95th out",
       -(SELECT quantileExact(0.95)(in_bps) FROM b) AS "95th in"
FROM b ORDER BY t

panels.description: Inbound mirrored below the axis, the usual way to read a transit graph. Flat lines are each direction's 95th over the whole range.

panels.title: Daily 95th percentile

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) AS t,
         sum(if(OutIfBoundary = 'external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / 300 AS out_bps,
         sum(if(InIfBoundary  = 'external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / 300 AS in_bps
  FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) GROUP BY t
)
SELECT toStartOfDay(t) AS time,
       quantileExact(0.95)(out_bps) AS "out",
       quantileExact(0.95)(in_bps)  AS "in"
FROM b GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Which days actually drive the monthly figure. One tall day can set the bill for the whole month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       if(DstNetName != '', DstNetName, concat('AS', toString(DstAS))) AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM $table
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
  AND DstAS IN (SELECT DstAS FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
      GROUP BY DstAS ORDER BY sum(Bytes * $sr) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       if(SrcNetName != '', SrcNetName, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS))) AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM $table
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND InIfBoundary = 'external'
  AND SrcAS IN (SELECT SrcAS FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND InIfBoundary = 'external'
      GROUP BY SrcAS ORDER BY sum(Bytes * $sr) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       DstCountry AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM $table
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND DstCountry != ''
  AND DstCountry IN (SELECT DstCountry FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND DstCountry != ''
      GROUP BY DstCountry ORDER BY sum(Bytes * $sr) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT DstCountry AS country, sum(Bytes * $sr) AS bytes
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND DstCountry != ''
GROUP BY country ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT if(DstNetName != '', DstNetName, concat('AS', toString(DstAS))) AS "network",
       DstAS AS "ASN",
       sum(Bytes * $sr) AS "bytes",
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) AS "avg bits/s",
       round(100 * sum(Bytes * $sr) / (SELECT sum(Bytes * $sr) FROM $table
             WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'), 2) AS "share %"
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
GROUP BY DstNetName, DstAS ORDER BY "bytes" DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Ports and protocols — these read the raw flows table, which keeps ports (15-day TTL)
Top 15 destination ports, outbound

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       concat(if(Proto=6,'tcp/',if(Proto=17,'udp/',concat('proto', toString(Proto), '/'))), toString(DstPort)) AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
  AND DstPort IN (SELECT DstPort FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
      GROUP BY DstPort ORDER BY sum(Bytes * $sr) DESC LIMIT 15)
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: SrcPort and DstPort exist only on the raw flows table — Akvorado drops them from every consolidated table. This panel therefore ignores $table and is bounded by the raw TTL.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       concat(if(Proto=6,'tcp/',if(Proto=17,'udp/',concat('proto', toString(Proto), '/'))), toString(DstPort)) AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND InIfBoundary = 'external'
  AND DstPort IN (SELECT DstPort FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND InIfBoundary = 'external'
      GROUP BY DstPort ORDER BY sum(Bytes * $sr) DESC LIMIT 15)
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       if(Proto=6,'TCP',if(Proto=17,'UDP',if(Proto=1,'ICMP',if(Proto=58,'ICMPv6',concat('proto ',toString(Proto)))))) AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Packet size distribution, outbound

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       PacketSizeBucket AS series,
       sum(Packets * $sr) / $bucket AS pps
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: A fleet skewing to the 0-63 and 64-127 buckets is being used to flood somebody. Pairs with the abuse dashboard's scan detector.

panels.title: By exporter and external interface, outbound

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       concat(ExporterName, ' ', OutIfName, if(OutIfProvider='','',concat(' (',OutIfProvider,')'))) AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: One series means single-homed transit. Interfaces with no SNMP description show as a bare name — worth fixing on the switch.

panels.title: External link utilisation

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       sum(if(OutIfBoundary='external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / $bucket
         / nullIf(max(if(OutIfBoundary='external', OutIfSpeed, 0)) * 1000000, 0) AS "out %",
       sum(if(InIfBoundary='external', Bytes, 0) * $sr) * 8 / $bucket
         / nullIf(max(if(InIfBoundary='external', InIfSpeed, 0)) * 1000000, 0) AS "in %"
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Throughput against the interface speed SNMP reports. Blank if the exporter does not report ifSpeed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       sumIf(Bytes * $sr, EType = 2048)  * 8 / $bucket AS "IPv4",
       sumIf(Bytes * $sr, EType = 34525) * 8 / $bucket AS "IPv6"
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Traffic by boundary pair

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       concat(toString(InIfBoundary), ' -> ', toString(OutIfBoundary)) AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: external->internal is inbound, internal->external is outbound. Anything external->external is transiting the network, which you are probably not being paid for. undefined means interface classifiers are not set.

panels.title: Outbound by network role

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       if(SrcNetRole = '', 'untagged', toString(SrcNetRole)) AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: From Akvorado's networks: config. A large 'untagged' band means prefixes are missing there — the same tagging the abuse detectors depend on.

panels.title: Top 10 customer addresses, outbound

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       replaceRegexpOne(toString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '') AS series,
       sum(Bytes * $sr) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND SrcNetRole = 'customer'
  AND SrcAddr IN (SELECT SrcAddr FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND SrcNetRole = 'customer'
      GROUP BY SrcAddr ORDER BY sum(Bytes * $sr) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Raw table only — addresses are dropped from consolidated tables.

panels.title: 95th percentile per customer address

targets.rawSql:
SELECT addr AS "address",
       quantileExact(0.95)(bps) AS "95th bits/s",
       max(bps) AS "peak bits/s",
       sum(bps) * 300 / 8 AS "bytes"
FROM (
  SELECT replaceRegexpOne(toString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '') AS addr,
         toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) AS t,
         sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / 300 AS bps
  FROM flows
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND SrcNetRole = 'customer'
  GROUP BY addr, t
)
GROUP BY addr ORDER BY "95th bits/s" DESC LIMIT 30

panels.description: Raw flows, because consolidated tables drop SrcAddr. Capped at the raw TTL (15 days by default), so it cannot produce a full monthly figure without raising it. SamplingRate is hard-coded rather than $sr: the raw table is unambiguously not pre-scaled.

panels.title: Who drove the bill — traffic during the 20 busiest 5-minute buckets

targets.rawSql:
WITH peak AS (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) AS t
  FROM flows
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
  GROUP BY t ORDER BY sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) DESC LIMIT 20
)
SELECT replaceRegexpOne(toString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '') AS "address",
       if(SrcNetRole = '', 'untagged', toString(SrcNetRole)) AS "role",
       sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / 6000 AS "mean bits/s at peak",
       max(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / 300 AS "burst bits/s",
       round(100 * sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) / nullIf((
         SELECT sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) FROM flows
         WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
           AND toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) IN (SELECT t FROM peak)), 0), 2) AS "share of peak %"
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND OutIfBoundary = 'external'
  AND toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 300 second) IN (SELECT t FROM peak)
GROUP BY "address", "role" ORDER BY "mean bits/s at peak" DESC LIMIT 30

panels.description: The 95th percentile is set by the busiest five-minute buckets, so this is the answer to 'who is responsible for the bill' — not who moved the most bytes overall, but who was sending when the link was at its fullest. A customer at the top here costs you money even if their monthly volume is modest. Raw flows, so bounded by the 15-day TTL.

panels.title: Flow records ingested and sampling rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS time,
       count() / $bucket AS "records/s",
       avg(SamplingRate) AS "mean sampling rate"
FROM $table WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Records/s is sampled flow records, not packets. A change in mean sampling rate silently rescales every other panel on this dashboard.

panels.title: Sampling, and why $sr is set the way it is

options.content:
Akvorado stores **raw sampled counts** in every table, consolidated ones included:
`Bytes` is per sampled record and must be multiplied by `SamplingRate`. That was
verified against this deployment by comparing one hour three ways —

| query | result |
| --- | --- |
| `sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)` on `flows` | 573,047,081,000 |
| `sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)` on `flows_5m0s` | 510,153,821,000 |
| `sum(Bytes)` on `flows_5m0s` | 510,153,821 |

The aggregated table matches the raw one only when multiplied, and is exactly
1000× short without it. **Leave `$sr` on `SamplingRate`.** The `1` option
exists only in case a future Akvorado version starts pre-scaling; re-run the
comparison after any upgrade that touches the schema.

`$bucket` should match `$table`: 300 for `flows_5m0s`, 3600 for `flows_1h0s`,
60 for `flows_1m0s`. The billing panels above ignore it and always use 300,
because five minutes is the interval the percentile is defined on.

Panels reading **ports or addresses** ignore `$table` and always read raw
`flows` — Akvorado drops `SrcAddr`, `DstAddr`, `SrcPort` and `DstPort` from
every consolidated table, so those panels are bounded by the raw TTL, 15 days
by default.
